record.confidence_note: Measured by probe on 2026-10-23: Cloudflare DoH returned Status 2 (SERVFAIL) with EDE(22) 'No Reachable Authority at delegation epikhost.com' and EDE(23) 'Network Error 87.117.238.51:53 returned REFUSED'; curl returned 'Could not resolve host'. A separate epikhost.org belongs to a different company and was not treated as the same provider.

evidence.proved: DoH Status 2 SERVFAIL, EDE 'No Reachable Authority at delegation epikhost.com', delegated NS 87.117.238.51 returned REFUSED; curl exit 6 for epikhost.com and www.epikhost.net

record.notes: The name appears in seedbox briefs but resolves to nothing. epikhost.org is a live but unrelated hosting company with a different name and no seedbox plans; treating them as one provider would be a false match. Re-probe before reuse.
